title: ProteoAnalystR: backend R functions for the ProteoAnalyst platform
description: The statistical and visualization backend R package that powers the ProteoAnalyst web platform. Provides readers for common upstream proteomics/phosphoproteomics outputs (MaxQuant, FragPipe, DIA-NN, Spectronaut, MSstats/MSstatsPTM long tables), normalization, peptide-to-protein summarization, imputation, differential expression (limma / DEqMS / edgeR / DESeq2), protein-adjusted PTM/occupancy analysis, functional and kinase enrichment, WGCNA/co-expression, PPI network construction, and biomarker/ROC analysis. Manuscript release v1.0.0.
